title: generate_relay_token params
description: Generates a new relay token for the running relay server. The token is registered with the relay after the command is read, for at most 15 seconds, and the response follows; other commands are handled meanwhile. The response carries token, ttl_ns, session_ttl_ns, expires_at and mode: "static" for a token derived for peer_pub_b64, "random" otherwise. Params that do not parse fail with invalid_params, and a peer_pub_b64 that is not a valid Ed25519 public key fails with invalid_peer_key.

peer_pub_b64.description: Base64-encoded public key of the peer to derive a static token for. The token admits only that peer: a session on it whose peer has another key is closed before session_started, whatever the verification mode let in, and the token is used up.
